newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin falls 15 cents as London price drops.
newsitem.headline: KL tin falls 15 cents as London price drops.

text.p: Tin price fell 15 ringgit to finish at 14.82 ringgit ($5.92) a kg with losses in London Metal Exchange affecting sentiment, traders said.
"The London market went down sharply and local tin had to follow suit," a trader said. "The short-term trend depends on the metals performance in the London market today."

Buyers were cautious and only 17 tonnes of bid was seen at the opening against offer of 118 tonnes. Final turnover remained unchanged at Monday's 93 tonnes. The price differential over London was at $50 a tonne premium against $40 previously. -Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911)($1=2.5020 rgt).
